rows.packSubjectName: Proposition 141: Prohibit tax; monitoring; vehicle mileage

passes.answer: Proposition 141 would change the Arizona Constitution to ban any tax or fee based on how many miles you drive. It would also stop the state, counties, cities and towns from tracking or limiting your driving miles unless you voluntarily agree to it. There are two exceptions: commercial vehicles that operate in more than one state under an interstate agreement for reporting fuel taxes or registration fees, and vehicles owned and operated by the state or a local government. It appears on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot. We have not recorded the final ballot wording; the title and analysis here come from the Arizona Legislative Council's adopted impartial analysis.
